features.feature: Commit a pilot campaign runner (run-pilot.mjs) adapting the identity-keyed campaign-resume pattern, emitting RUN-RECORD-conformant arm-run directories
Runner enumerates (fixture x arm) cells from generated corpus manifest + committed run-order seed
Runner skips cells whose run dir already has a terminal run.json (identity-keyed resume)
Runner copies fixture workspace into fresh mkdtemp non-git root per cell (store isolation)
Runner executes host task under LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ID/arm env and captures run-scoped activity.jsonl slice + post-run workspace
Runner writes run.json with every RUN-RECORD.md required field (experimentId, arm, hostId, storeRoot, timings, commandCount, doneReached, validationPass)
Runner dry-run mode (--plan) prints cell plan without executing
Runner never writes to the production .lattice/learning store
Runner asserts resolvedLearningRoot equals the isolated mkdtemp root before host execution and aborts if not
Runner refuses/precondition-checks that leakage-audit has passed for the corpus before running
Mechanical fixture-leakage audit (leakage-audit.mjs): grep-based strip-list scan over every generated fixture workspace/ + prompt.md against LEAKAGE_STRIP_LIST markers
Leakage audit writes leakage-audit.jsonl rows {fixtureId, checks, pass} and exits nonzero on any leak
Leakage audit asserts reference-bad/reference-good/oracle.mjs are outside workspace/ and prompt.md never names the trap class
Verification matrix row: fixture leakage audit proves neither arm can derive the trap answer from the fixture tree (section 14)
Protocol freeze via protocol.mjs freeze: bind fixture manifest + run-order seed + memory-snapshot hash to experimentId (section 8 / section 13 M6)
Pilot execution: at least 5 fixtures per trap group through BOTH arms (6 in-store + 2 held-out + clean)
Pilot includes at least 15 control-arm fault-task runs (section 7 freeze rule precondition)
Score every run dir with score.mjs into score-records.jsonl under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/
Store isolation verification: zero voided records (every score record asserts isolated storeRoot, not production .lattice/learning/)
Verification matrix row: store isolation — resolved learning root for every arm-run is the experiment temp root, never the production store (section 14)
Scorer agreement on replay: re-scoring every archived run dir a second time is byte-identical (section 13 M6 exit criterion)
Control-arm records show memoryPackShown=false and treatment records show memoryPackShown=true
Verification matrix row: memory snapshot hash identical before and after the powered run (section 14)
Compute Wilson 95% CI of the observed control-arm defect rate from >=15 control-arm fault runs
Freeze powered N via sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck at N-maximizing baseline within the Wilson 95% CI (p* = 0.5 + mde/2 clamped to CI)
If CI width > 0.30, extend the pilot before freezing N
If pilot baseline falls outside the planning band (0.5-0.8), record the recompute note instead of silently proceeding
Record frozen per-population N + freeze inputs into experiment evidence root (n-freeze.json) referenced by protocol experimentId, ready for M7

Section 12: evidence artifacts directory structure under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ (protocol.json, fixture-manifest.jsonl, pair-ledger.jsonl, run-order-seed.json, memory-snapshot-hash.json, score-records.jsonl, leakage-audit.jsonl)
Section 17 step 2: S7 freeze rule — powered N frozen at the N-maximizing baseline within Wilson 95% CI
M1/M3/M4 tools (fixture-generator.mjs, trap-templates.mjs, score.mjs, sample-size.mjs, protocol.mjs, pair-ledger.mjs, RUN-RECORD.md) are not modified by this story
features.excluded_by: Any change to M1/M3/M4 deliverables (fixture-generator.mjs, trap-templates.mjs, score.mjs, sample-size.mjs, protocol.mjs, pair-ledger.mjs, RUN-RECORD.md) and packages/**

features.feature: experiments/recovery-runner/** (proven scratch) is not touched by this story
The powered M7 campaign, M8 live readout, M9 evidence map are not part of this story
